title: Chapter 1145: 12: The Explosive Lin Yuan (Seeking Subscription)

Chapter 1145: 12: The Explosive Lin Yuan (Seeking Subscription)

Chapter 1145: Chapter 12: The Explosive Lin Yuan (Seeking Subscription)

Chaos Qi drifted.

The nine Chaos Great Saints patiently waited for the time-space storm to settle within the Xuanhuang Universe.

With the Chaos Great Saints unmoving, the surrounding Chaos Venerables naturally dared not approach.

More than a hundred Chaos Venerables gathered here, and even if they combined forces, they could not perfectly merge their powers to threaten any single Chaos Great Saint.

In the Source World, using the war machines containing Chaos Secret Patterns, the Great Lord might pose a threat to the Heavenly Venerate.

But in the Chaos Void? There is no such statement.

Rumble!

At a certain moment—

The corner of the Xuanhuang Universe that was revealed fell into complete tranquility, with the outer time-space disappearing, revealing an entrance to the universe’s interior.

“Hahaha, we can go in now.” Black Light Great Saint’s eyes were filled with endless darkness as he stepped forward, causing darkness to spread and cover.

The area shrouded in darkness became utterly silent, even the Chaos Qi ceased to exist.

The path of Chaos Power evolved by Black Light Great Saint is called Chaos Darkness. The Chaos Darkness here is incredibly pure, akin to an enhanced version of the Chaos Shadow mastered by the Shadow Demon Great Saint.

“The Black Light Domain is an extension of Black Light Great Saint’s own power. Ordinary Venerables shrouded by this domain find it difficult to break free and are basically suppressed.”

“Rest assured, Black Light Great Saint won’t specifically suppress you. His adversaries are the other eight Great Saints.”

The surrounding Chaos Venerables shuddered inwardly.

Some Venerables, with cunning thoughts, had intended to sneak in at the moment the time-space storm subsided.

But under the shroud of Black Light Great Saint’s Black Light Domain, that possibility was virtually severed.

“Hmm?”

In the distance, the Shadow Demon Great Saint, who was about to be the first to rush into the Xuanhuang Universe, was similarly enveloped by the Black Light Domain, suddenly sensing that the surrounding time-space was like amber, firmly suppressing him.

The Black Light Domain can hardly completely bind a Chaos Great Saint, but suppressing and restraining is simple, at least for now. The Shadow Demon Great Saint noticed a significant drop in his speed, unable to use time-space traversal means to enter the Xuanhuang Universe and could only fly in slowly.

“Hahaha, I’ll go in first then.”

A smile appeared on Black Light Great Saint’s face. Under the shroud of the Black Light Domain, other Great Saints couldn’t traverse time-space, but he could.

So he could completely be the first to enter the Xuanhuang Universe.

Don’t underestimate being the first to enter the Xuanhuang Universe. In the universe developed and left behind by such a peerless Great Saint, entering even half a minute earlier gives a significant lead.

Let alone being the first to enter?

Buzz!

Suddenly, two streams of blue-gray aura rapidly spread, intersecting and colliding with the Black Light Domain, and time-space began to shatter heavily.

“What is this?”

Black Light Great Saint’s expression changed. Under the shock of the blue-gray aura, he too was unable to perform time-space traversal.

The prerequisite for time-space traversal is relative stability of time-space, but now the time-space is utterly chaotic, forcing traversal at this time means indiscriminate traversal, and there’s a significant chance of being driven away from the Xuanhuang Universe.

Realizing this, Black Light Great Saint immediately ceased his intention to traverse time-space.

Forced traversal right now might get him into the Xuanhuang Universe first, but it might also send him elsewhere. Even if not far from here, by the time he rushes back,

it’s estimated that the other eight Great Saints would have already gone in, and even part of the Chaos Venerables might have entered.

If not traversing time-space, Black Light Great Saint could at least ensure he would be among the top three to enter the Xuanhuang Universe.

“Black Light, you want to go in first? Did you ask me?”

The Dual Origin Great Saint, with his two-horned head, sneered as his horns, one blue and one gray, continuously vibrated with the power of time-space, centered around them rapidly spreading.

He too was bound by the Black Light Domain, unable to perform time-space traversal.

But though the Dual Origin Great Saint couldn’t traverse himself, he had ways to prevent Black Light from traversing.

“Hahaha, Black Light, if you have the ability, try traversing now?” Wild Barbarian Great Saint immediately laughed aloud.

Although he was confident in not being inferior to Black Light Great Saint, the latter’s methods were more numerous than his. Without the Dual Origin Great Saint, Wild Barbarian Great Saint would have likely watched helplessly as Black Light Great Saint became the first to enter the Xuanhuang Universe.

Now it’s just right. Black Light and Dual Origin mutually restrained each other, causing everyone to be unable to perform time-space traversal, which is naturally most beneficial for him, Wild Barbarian Great Saint.

“Black Light Great Saint…” Within the endless darkness, Lin Yuan was also among them, similarly feeling the pressure.

Regarding time-space attainments, he wasn’t superior to the Chaos Great Saints present, so he couldn’t perform time-space traversal either. To enter the Xuanhuang Universe, he could only fly in.

“The Chaos Great Saints have all evolved their own power paths from chaos, mastering numerous mystical methods, in which I’m indeed inferior.”

Lin Yuan thought to himself.

Along the path of growth, Lin Yuan’s most adept at comprehending rules, but compared to the Chaos Great Saints, it didn’t provide much advantage.

“In that case, let’s rely on our own abilities.”

Black Light Great Saint sneered and showed no intention of retracting the Black Light Domain.

Although the Dual Origin Great Saint disrupted time-space with his own power, preventing himself from performing time-space traversal, with the enhancement of the Black Light Domain, he would still fly a bit faster than the other Great Saints even if flying slowly.

Swoosh!

Black Light Great Saint transformed into a pure darkness and fled towards the Xuanhuang Universe.

“Black Light, did you forget about me?” Wild Barbarian Great Saint laughed aloud, clenched his big hand, and struck toward the direction where Black Light Great Saint was fleeing.

Immediately.

Time-space once again shattered violently, and Black Light Great Saint had no choice but to stop, turning to look at the Wild Barbarian Great Saint striding over.

“This is bad.”

Black Light Great Saint frowned, “I was too eager, showing the ability to be the first to enter the Xuanhuang Universe, only to become the target of both Dual Origin and Wild Barbarian.”

At this moment, Black Light Great Saint also realized the key issue.

In terms of strength, he wasn’t much stronger than Wild Barbarian and Dual Origin, but the Black Light Domain was very suitable for such treasure-grabbing situations.

In this scenario, the equally matched Wild Barbarian and Dual Origin would instinctively join forces, even without prior discussions, to jointly deal with him.

“Since that’s the case, no one should think about going in.”

Black Light Great Saint gritted his teeth, fully activating the Black Light Domain, even abandoning its enhancement on himself, to suppress the Wild Barbarian and Dual Origin Great Saints.

Boom.

The three Great Saints attacked each other, with terrifying aftershocks spreading out in all directions.

“I can’t squeeze in at all.” Tian Lu Great Saint was at the back, trying to bypass the three Great Saints, Black Light, Dual Origin, and Wild Barbarian, and enter the Xuanhuang Universe first.

But he found that not only couldn’t he get in first, he couldn’t even get close.

The closer he got to the space-time where the three Great Saints were, the greater the constraining pressure he felt.

Tian Lu Great Saint even had the feeling that if he forcibly went in, he might face a joint attack from the three Great Saints.

The three Great Saints, Black Light, Dual Origin, and Wild Barbarian, were counterbalancing each other, but if any other Great Saint dared to fish in troubled waters, they would surely face an attack from the three Saints ahead.

“Forget it, forget it.”

“There’s no need to be the first one in.”

Tian Lu Great Saint pondered for a while and finally gave up.

With his survival abilities, none of the three, Black Light, Dual Origin, or Wild Barbarian, could do anything to him alone.

But if the three of them joined forces? Even a single blow might seriously injure him.

At the crucial time of entering the Xuanhuang Universe, if he were seriously injured? Not only would he lose the qualification to compete with the three Great Saints ahead, but even the newly emerged Great Saints behind might be able to ride on top of him.

…

“This is the power of a Great Saint.”

Among many Chaos Venerables, Divine Wind Venerable was quite emotional. In the struggle of nine Chaos Great Saints, they as Chaos Venerables couldn’t intervene at all.

Only after the nine Chaos Great Saints entered could they dare to go in.

That’s why there were more than a hundred Venerables gathered on the field, yet none had the slightest intention of competing with the Great Saints.

The gap between the two sides was simply too vast.

If it weren’t for the fact that those nine Great Saints looked down on them and were balancing each other, just one could probably clear out all the Venerables.

“Everyone, stay close.”

Divine Wind Venerable sent a voice message to the more than ten other Venerables around.

They certainly didn’t dare to enter the Xuanhuang Universe before the Great Saints or even enter together with them.

But after all the Great Saints entered the Xuanhuang Universe, who follows closely behind becomes very important.

The power of the Black Light Domain enveloped them, and even after Black Light Great Saint entered the Xuanhuang Universe, it wouldn’t dissipate immediately, making it impossible for the Venerables to traverse space and time.

Therefore, once the Great Saints entered the Xuanhuang Universe, whoever was nearest to the entrance could enter first.

But this ‘staying close’ must be measured, not too close, or they’ll fall behind the other Venerables, nor too close, lest they provoke a Great Saint to strike, ending in disaster.

Even a Chaos Realm peak Venerable couldn’t withstand a casual blow from a Great Saint.

…

“This Black Light Domain…”

Lin Yuan was also flying towards the entrance of the Xuanhuang Universe, also feeling the suppression of the Black Light Domain.

“Flying slowly, I will surely be among the last few to enter the Xuanhuang Universe.” Lin Yuan frowned, although he had the ‘map’ inside the Xuanhuang Universe, it was certainly best to enter first.

“With the Dual Origin Great Saint shaking space-time, even without the Black Light Domain, I can’t perform space-time traversal.”

Lin Yuan looked towards Dual Origin Great Saint, who was already very close to the entrance of the Xuanhuang Universe.

“Chaos evolution power? Truly difficult to deal with.” Lin Yuan rarely felt this kind of all-encompassing suppression, his aura subtly brewing, “No choice but to go head-on.”

Boom!!!

Lin Yuan seemed to transform into an eternal Fierce Sun, the space-time attributes within ten thousand, a hundred thousand, a million light years were all distorted, under the illumination of the Fierce Sun’s brilliance, everything turned into his domain.

The Black Light Domain of Black Light Great Saint and the blue-gray power of Dual Origin Great Saint quickly retreated under the pervasive glow of the Fierce Sun.

At least in the space-time surrounding Lin Yuan, these two forces were swiftly expelled.

Rustle.

Space-time regained stability,

Lin Yuan tore with his right hand, ripping the void before him, then stepped inside.

In an instant, he appeared ahead of Black Light, Dual Origin, and Wild Barbarian Great Saints.

“Hmm?”

The three Great Saints, who were balancing each other in battle, showed astonished expressions, looking at Lin Yuan who was about to rip the void again and step into the Xuanhuang Universe.

…..

…..

…..
